findings.claim: `tprod_nonneg` requires `[L.NeBot]`, but its statement doesn't need it. The other `tprod` sign/bound lemmas in this file (`one_le_tprod`, whose additive form is `tsum_nonneg`, `tprod_le_one`, and `tprod_le_of_prod_le'`) take no `L.NeBot` instance. They handle the `¬ L.NeBot` case separately with `tprod_bot hL`. If ¬L.NeBot, `∏'[L] i, f i` reduces to `∏ᶠ i, f i`, and that is still nonnegative under the PR's own assumptions (`ZeroLEOneClass`, `PosMulMono`). As written, the lemma is strictly weaker than its sibling `tsum_nonneg`, and any caller with a general summation filter `L` has to supply an instance the conclusion doesn't depend on. Separately, the `Multipliable` branch re-proves `HasProd.nonneg` inline (via `ge_of_tendsto'` and `prod_nonneg`) instead of calling the lemma added just above it.
findings.requested_change:
Remove `[L.NeBot]` from `tprod_nonneg` and add the bottom-filter case, following the pattern of `one_le_tprod`/`tprod_le_one`. In the multipliable case, reuse `HasProd.nonneg`. For example:
  by_cases hfL : Multipliable f L
  · by_cases hL : L.NeBot
    · exact hfL.hasProd.nonneg hf
    · simp only [tprod_bot hL]
      exact finprod_induction (0 ≤ ·) zero_le_one (fun _ _ ↦ mul_nonneg) hf
  · simp [tprod_eq_one_of_not_multipliable hfL]
Keep `[L.NeBot]` on `HasProd.nonneg`. It is needed there, because `HasProd f a ⊥` holds for every `a`.

review_notes: I read the diff against the whole Order.lean. The `tprod_nonneg` finding comes from the file itself: `one_le_tprod` (additive `tsum_nonneg`), `tprod_le_one` and `tprod_le_of_prod_le'` all drop `L.NeBot` by splitting on it and using `tprod_bot`. `tprod_le_one` also shows the `finprod_induction` pattern for the bottom-filter case, and `mul_nonneg` only needs `PosMulMono`, so the PR's assumptions are enough. I checked the instance assumptions: `ZeroLEOneClass` is needed for the empty product and for the non-multipliable case (0 ≤ 1); `ClosedIciTopology` is what `le_hasProd_of_le_prod` and `ge_of_tendsto'` need; `L.NeBot` is genuinely needed in `HasProd.nonneg`. I looked at four other possible requests and filed none: (1) renaming section `WithZero`, since `WithZero` is also a type, to `MonoidWithZero`; (2) moving the repeated instance binders into a section `variable` like the rest of the file; (3) mixing `lemma` and `theorem` and using `x` instead of `i` as the bound variable. All three are style preferences, not defects. (4) A `positivity` extension for `tprod` to match `evalTsum` would be scope creep for this PR. `tprod_nonneg` doesn't clash with `tsum_nonneg`, which is the additive name of `one_le_tprod`, and there is no meaningful `to_additive` counterpart. I couldn't search the rest of Mathlib for an existing duplicate, because the packet contains only this file.
